chapters.summary: Ruth 1 tells how Elimelech's family moves to Moab because of famine, and after tragedy strikes, Naomi returns to Bethlehem with her daughter-in-law Ruth, who clings faithfully to her.
keyPoints: Elimelech takes his wife and sons to live in Moab to escape a famine in Bethlehem.
Elimelech and both of his sons die, leaving Naomi alone with her two daughters-in-law.
Naomi urges her daughters-in-law to return to their own families, but Ruth refuses to leave her and goes back with her to Bethlehem.
chapters.application: In life's hardships, let us follow Ruth's example—clinging to those we love with faithfulness, and trusting God to lead us, confident that he will bless our devotion.

chapters.summary: Ruth gleans in the fields of Boaz and receives his kindness and protection, revealing God's care and provision.
keyPoints: Ruth humbly and diligently asks permission to glean, and Boaz grants her request.
Boaz shows Ruth kindness, providing food for her and instructing his workers to protect her.
Ruth shares what she has gathered with Naomi, showing their mutual love and God's watchful care.
chapters.application: In the ordinary tasks of daily life, let us respond to God's grace with faith and hard work, and care for others as well, trusting that God sees and provides for our needs.

chapters.summary: Following Naomi's instructions, Ruth goes at night to the threshing floor and lies down at the feet of Boaz, asking him to act as kinsman-redeemer, and Boaz agrees and protects her.
keyPoints: Naomi seeks security for Ruth's future and instructs her on how to approach Boaz.
Ruth obeys and goes to the threshing floor at night, lying at Boaz's feet to signal her request for him to redeem her.
Boaz praises Ruth's character and promises to settle the matter according to the law, sending her home with six measures of barley.
chapters.application: At life's turning points, let us be humble and obedient like Ruth, trusting God to guide us, while holding fast to integrity and waiting on his timing—he will open the way for those who remain faithful.

chapters.summary: At the town gate, Boaz legally redeems Elimelech's property and marries Ruth according to the law, and their son Obed becomes the grandfather of King David, revealing God's faithful care.
keyPoints: Boaz meets with the closer kinsman-redeemer at the town gate and, in accordance with the law, redeems the property and marries Ruth.
The elders and townspeople witness the transaction and bless the couple, praying that Ruth will build up the family like Rachel and Leah.
Ruth bears a son, Obed, who becomes David's grandfather, showing God's wonderful design at work even in ordinary life.
chapters.application: In everyday life, let us treat others with faithfulness and integrity, trusting that God is quietly at work behind the scenes, turning our obedience into a channel of blessing that fulfills his good purposes.
